notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Fixed destructible terrain - now no invisible surface that missiles used to hit
Also terraforming (using tools or explosions) is faster up to 2 times depending on the action
Physics quality is improved (in cost of some performance) on your requests
Random maps can be copied to "clipboard" so you can load them in the editor

notes.title: Destructive physics RELEASE UPDATE #1.0
notes.content:
[h3]OPTIMIZATION[/h3]
[b]Physics[/b]
• Debris performance significantly increased (+ 30-200%)
• Walls performance slightly increased (+ 10-40%)

[b]Fire system[/b]
• When you turn off fire particles, they no longer load the GPU
• Burnt parts change material to non-animated to reduce GPU usage

[b]Object freezing system[/b]
• The debris will automatically turn off its physicality under certain conditions to reduce CPU load, and turn it on if necessary
• If [i]Combine debris [/i] is enabled, they will be merged into 1 model with disabled physics to reduce the rendering-load on the CPU

[h3]New stuff[/h3]
[b]Timer and dynamic explosives editor[/b]
[strike]Hmmm but it doesn't do anything... Could this be for the next update?[/strike]
• Now, by pressing Alt, the explosion radius of all charges will be displayed.
• If you were aiming at the explosive when pressing Alt, a small editor will open where you can change the radius of the explosion and set a timer.
• Pressing T  starts the stopwatch and everything explodes in accordance with the set delay.

[b]Other changes[/b]
• Ladder added to editor
• Fixed minor bugs

[previewyoutube=bK8cxzRQoPo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Destructive physics UPDATE #0.6.2
notes.content:
[h1]Explosions [/h1]
A new option is now available in the graphics settings, it allows you to choose whether the explosions will be processed on the GPU or CPU.
If GPU - explosions will consist of thousands of particles, at the moment there is a limit of 200 thousand particles from 1 explosion (if you are experiencing performance problems related to their visualization or if you want to see more particles at once - let me know).
Whereas on the processor these are animated billboards (up to 200 per explosion).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36409399/491e36f49729a90ef06687230e8d94761cfca9f5.jpg[/img]

[b]Small changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Maps from the editor can now be copied to the clipboard, and to load you just need to copy the line to clipboard and press the following button in Editor
[*] Now the mannequin tries to stand straight even harder! Yes, now he almost does not fall
[*] Fireworks! (No real damage)
[*] Fixed some bugs with the interface and loading settings
[/list]


[i][strike]I've bought a new headphones to hear all your feedback... [/strike]Have fun destroying in this game :)[/i]

notes.title: Destructive physics UPDATE #0.6.1
notes.content:
[h1]Physical player[/h1]
Bat tab and physical model
Everything will be in development and will be improved in future updates.
[b]Weapons[/b]
When choosing.
Tornado and singularity got a radius change. Dynamite can get stick to any surface with custom force
[b]Mannequin[/b]
Now he is trying to stand straight! Yeah, finally he doesn`t fall immediately. Well at least he tries to, so do not place him on walls - he doesnt like it.

[b]Small changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cannonballs now automatically choose a method physics calculating so now they should not "get stuck" when flying through a pile of debris (it also help performance a little)
[*] Fixed disappearance of sounds during missiles spam
[*] Fixed surface deformation during explosion spam
[*] Explosions push debris a bit stronger to the sides
[*] Mannequin looks in the same direction as you
[/list]


[i][strike]I`ve bought a new mouse to make games with less amount of wires... [/strike]Have fun destroying in this game :)[/i]

notes.title: Destructive physics UPDATE #0.5.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]New weaponry[/b][/h1]
Custom pack was removed... as all of them - but it`s for better!
[b]Slot system:[/b] 
Now you can place any gun into slot to access it pressing 1-9 on keyboard
Most of the guns can be tuned. It means you can adjust weapon radius or velocity before putting it into slot.
Set 9 different missiles and destroy maps with missiles only or take all types of guns...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36409399/8e5ee2d2048bca3d39e5fa6622555e9dba8fa4af.jpg[/img]


[h2]Small changes:[/h2]
[b]Better slow-mo physics[/b] 
Now force will be properly applied to debris (it used to be lower when time was slowed down)

[b]Sounds[/b] 
New sound system will reduce sound of 100 explosions to protect your ears ;)

[b]Tornado[/b] 
New physics system also applied to tornado. And with some extra changes it should become a bit more tasty.

[b]Skybox[/b] 
Now sky looks different.

[i][b]Glass[/b] 
I have bought a new Glass to drink water from... Have fun destroying in this game :)[/i]

notes.title: Destructive physics update
notes.content:
[b]Terrain  deformation[/b]
X2 detailed terrain for better destruction!
Just change terrain when choosing a map and that`s it - not you can dig it all
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36409399/21e78151459d3e7c56cd9b6f98713c70a0a1cc52.jpg[/img]

[b]Procedual explosions[/b]
Reduce GPU load by enabling this feature in Graphics. Explosions close to each other will produce a bit less particles

[b]Minor fixes:[/b]
- Inventory custom gun
- Balls will always spawn when you shoot them
- And they will always collide with walls
- HUD can be fully hiden (press H)
